selected.title: Canada opens stablecoin consultation
selected.summary: The Canadian government has kicked off a 60-day public consultation on draft stablecoin regulations that would maintain a ban on yield payments.
selected.why: Canada launched a public consultation on new draft stablecoin regulations.

reason: Canada's stablecoin ban on yield payments tests whether financial regulation should restrict product features or market access—a live policy debate with testable outcomes.
angle: Prohibiting yield on stablecoins protects depositors from shadow banking but sacrifices competitive efficiency and may push yield-seeking users to riskier alternatives.
